"Scattergun"
Obtained through plundering a new rare NPC fleet in the Caribbean Sea (don't know the name; somebody want to help out with that?), and was also released in the Late Summer Premium Bottle released on 9/2. Stats:

+2 Sniping
+1 Assault
+1 Evasion
10k fame to equip, no class restrictions
